usedFor: Creem holds products and discount codes, and “New Product Is Added” starts a template when a product is created.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Product” in Creem
bestTemplate.why: A product added in the shop is created in Creem too, with its pricing.

watchOut: “Delete Discount” in Creem works by code or ID, so check which one an earlier step passes.
